I decided this case goes to a person in payments. The refund runbook lists only two expected exceptions, and this `System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException` is not one of them. Its Decisions table sends every unlisted exception to payments, and no agent may change payments code, so I did not investigate or attempt a fix.

The failure is in `RefundOrder` (`src/OrderService/Api/Refund.cs`, line 12) while refunding order 1005: `startIndex ('-4') must be a non-negative value`. Payments needs to check whether the customer was refunded to the card on `payment_ref` before anyone retries. The case is written at `/workspace/demos/louis-agent/data/triage/people/eval-refund-1005-20261127-060003-triage-1.md`.
